coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed all nervous, brain/eye, thermoregulation, endocrine, renal, reproductive and plant content. Existing methods and detailed mechanisms retained. Added neural/hormonal comparison, eyeball-length explanation, kidney-data interpretation and controlled tip experiments. Rejected SR claim that liver cells produce insulin, that all reflexes exclude the brain, that a tip cap stops auxin production, and undated IVF percentages. Kept AQA scope: no detailed nephron or extra hormone pathways required.
